v.t: Has there come upon man a period of time when he was nothing to be mentioned
v.l: Hal 'Ata `Ala Al-'Insani Hinun Mina Ad-Dahri Lam Yakun Shay'aan Madhkuraan

v.t: We created man from a liquid mixture, to test him; and We made him hearing and seeing
v.l: Inna Khalaqna Al-'Insana Min Nutfatin 'Amshajin Nabtalihi Faja`alnahu Sami`aan Basiraan

v.t: We guided him to the way, be he appreciative or unappreciative
v.l: Inna Hadaynahu As-Sabila 'Imma Shakiraan Wa 'Imma Kafuraan

v.t: We have prepared for the faithless chains, and yokes, and a Searing Fire
v.l: Inna 'A`tadna Lilkafirina Salasilaan Wa 'Aghlalaan Wa Sa`iraan

v.t: But the righteous will drink from a cup whose mixture is aroma
v.l: Inna Al-'Abrara Yashrabuna Min Ka'sin Kana Mizajuha Kafuraan

v.t: A spring from which the servants of God will drink, making it gush abundantly
v.l: Aynaan Yashrabu Biha `Ibadu Allahi Yufajjirunaha Tafjiraan

v.t: They fulfill their vows, and dread a Day whose ill is widespread
v.l: Yufuna Bin-Nadhri Wa Yakhafuna Yawmaan Kana Sharruhu Mustatiraan

v.t: And they feed, for the love of Him, the poor, and the orphan, and the captive
v.l: Wa Yut`imuna At-Ta`ama `Ala Hubbihi Miskinaan Wa Yatimaan Wa 'Asiraan

v.t: “We only feed you for the sake of God. We want from you neither compensation, nor gratitude
v.l: Innama Nut`imukum Liwajhi Allahi La Nuridu Minkum Jaza'an Wa La Shukuraan

v.t: We dread from our Lord a frowning grim Day.”
v.l: Inna Nakhafu Min Rabbina Yawmaan `Abusaan Qamtariraan

v.t: So God will protect them from the ills of that Day, and will grant them radiance and joy
v.l: Fawaqahumu Allahu Sharra Dhalika Al-Yawmi Wa Laqqahum Nađratan Wa Sururaan
w: and will cause them to meet

v.t: And will reward them for their patience with a Garden and silk
v.l: Wa Jazahum Bima Sabaru Jannatan Wa Hariraan

v.t: Reclining therein on the thrones; experiencing therein neither sun, nor frost
v.l: Muttaki'ina Fiha `Ala Al-'Ara'iki La Yarawna Fiha Shamsaan Wa La Zamhariraan

v.t: Its shade hovering over them, and its fruit brought low within reach
v.l: Wa Daniyatan `Alayhim Zilaluha Wa Dhullilat Qutufuha Tadhlilaan

v.t: Passing around them are vessels of silver, and cups of crystal
v.l: Wa Yutafu `Alayhim Bi'aniyatin Min Fiđđatin Wa 'Akwabin Kanat Qawarira

v.t: Crystal of silver—they measured them exactly
v.l: Qawarira Min Fiđđatin Qaddaruha Taqdiraan

v.t: They will be served therein with a cup whose flavor is Zanjabeel
v.l: Wa Yusqawna Fiha Ka'saan Kana Mizajuha Zanjabilaan
w: And they will be given to drink

v.t: A spring therein named Salsabeel
v.l: Aynaan Fiha Tusamma Salsabilaan

v.t: Passing among them are eternalized youths. If you see them, you would think them sprinkled pearls
v.l: Wa Yatufu `Alayhim Wildanun Mukhalladuna 'Idha Ra'aytahum Hasibtahum Lu'ulu'uaan Manthuraan

v.t: Wherever you look, you see bliss, and a vast kingdom
v.l: Wa 'Idha Ra'ayta Thamma Ra'ayta Na`imaan Wa Mulkaan Kabiraan

v.t: Upon them are garments of green silk, and satin. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Lord will offer them a pure drink
v.l: Aliyahum Thiyabu Sundusin Khuđrun Wa 'Istabraqun Wa Hullu 'Asawira Min Fiđđatin Wa Saqahum Rabbuhum Sharabaan Tahuraan
w: and will give them to drink

v.t: “This is a reward for you. Your efforts are well appreciated.”
v.l: Inna Hadha Kana Lakum Jaza'an Wa Kana Sa`yukum Mashkuraan

v.t: It is We who sent down the Quran upon you—a gradual revelation
v.l: Inna Nahnu Nazzalna `Alayka Al-Qur'ana Tanzilaan

v.t: So be patient for the decision of your Lord, and do not obey the sinner or the blasphemer among them
v.l: Fasbir Lihukmi Rabbika Wa La Tuti` Minhum 'Athimaan 'Aw Kafuraan

v.t: And mention the Name of your Lord, morning and evening
v.l: Wa Adhkur Asma Rabbika Bukratan Wa 'Asilaan

v.t: And for part of the night, prostrate yourself to Him, and glorify Him long into the night
v.l: Wa Mina Al-Layli Fasjud Lahu Wa Sabbihhu Laylaan Tawilaan

v.t: As for these: they love the fleeting life, and leave behind a Heavy Day
v.l: Inna Ha'uula' Yuhibbuna Al-`Ajilata Wa Yadharuna Wara'ahum Yawmaan Thaqilaan

v.t: We created them, and strengthened their frame; and whenever We will, We can replace them with others like them
v.l: Nahnu Khalaqnahum Wa Shadadna 'Asrahum Wa 'Idha Shi'na Baddalna 'Amthalahum Tabdilaan

v.t: This is a reminder; so whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord
v.l: Inna Hadhihi Tadhkiratun Faman Sha'a Attakhadha 'Ila Rabbihi Sabilaan

v.t: Yet you cannot will, unless God wills. God is Knowing and Wise
v.l: Wa Ma Tasha'una 'Illa 'An Yasha'a Allahu 'Inna Allaha Kana `Alimaan Hakimaan

v.t: He admits into His mercy whomever He wills. But as for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
v.l: Yudkhilu Man Yasha'u Fi Rahmatihi Wa Az-Zalimina 'A`adda Lahum `Adhabaan 'Alimaan
